audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer uses Viktor's pre-rework ability names Chaos Storm and Death Ray; real names are Arcane Storm (R) and Hextech Ray (E). breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown number. Q auto-reset burst tell (from missingInteractions) was absent.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: R = Arcane Storm, E = Hextech Ray. Gravity Field is 17s at rank 1 / 13s max, Q 9s early — numbers make the advice concrete.
audit.corrected: All Chaos Storm/Death Ray mentions renamed; cooldown numbers added; Siphon Power auto-reset wind-up added as the back-off cue in dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: missingInteractions suggested 'Arcane Storm is a channel — Pick a Card cancels it', but Riot's own R text says the storm INTERRUPTS enemy channels and persists/redirects — it is not itself a cancellable channel. Derived 'channel' flag misfires; per calibration rules I trusted the description and did NOT add this claim.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: His engage opens with a Siphon Power auto reset — the wind-up is your cue: lock yellow then, stun his step-up, and back off.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Post-6 a shoved mid wave is a coupon for a cross-map Destiny — farming mid through his 17s Gravity Field downtime wastes your one edge.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1, 13s max. The stun zone owns every all-in: step up only in that downtime. - His Q shield cycles every 9s early — poke between casts. Keep gold card for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: Viktor wins by landing Gravity Field, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Viktor wins by catching you in Gravity Field, eating card pokes with his Q shield, and pinning the wave so you can't roam.
